Interface Backend

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlloyBackend
public interface Backend
A solver of a model behind the solution loop (Repl): Choco for a static model, whose solutions are instances, and Alloy for a temporal model, whose solutions are traces. The loop keeps the solutions shown and their views; the backend solves, and handles its own commands with its own messages.
